description.value: Coast Capri Hotel is a full-service hotel on Harvey Avenue — one of Kelowna's main cross-city routes — making it a practical base for touring cyclists exploring Okanagan wine country, downtown waterfront, and nearby parks. The hotel offers on-site dining at Vintners Restaurant and a Coffeecopia coffee bar in the lobby, plus a seasonal heated outdoor pool. Its location near Capri Centre Mall keeps a range of services within easy reach for cyclists resupplying or resting between legs.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active full-service hotel on Harvey Avenue, Kelowna, with free wi-fi explicitly stated as a brand standard and on-site dining at Vintners Restaurant. The FAQ page corroborates the OSM phone number (250.860.6060) and email (reservations@coastcaprihotel.com). No cyclist-specific amenities — bike storage, tools, bike wash, e-bike charging — are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all bike-related required criteria remain null.
concerns: Secure bike storage not mentioned on website — required criterion unverifiable from available evidence.
Staff bike handling procedure not referenced anywhere on website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate operational hotel in a prime Okanagan cycling destination, but neither required criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) is confirmed anywhere on the website. Direct contact needed to verify cyclist-specific infrastructure before listing.

Nearby evening food.detail: Vintners Restaurant on site; Coffeecopia Gourmet Coffee Bar in lobby
